profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Uber
profile.summary:
As a Senior Software Engineer at Uber, my mission revolves around enhancing production security through innovative cloud solutions and robust security systems. Our team has successfully spearheaded the development of Uber's serverless platform, enabling seamless transitions across cloud providers and bolstering operational efficiency in the process. 

My efforts in cross-team collaborations have been instrumental in integrating fleet reliability with security, leading to significant advancements in our operational practices. Spearheading the Uber PKI and JIT access initiatives, I've played a key role in securing privileged escalations company-wide. These contributions reflect my commitment to maintaining the integrity and resilience of Uber's infrastructure.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Production Security at Uber.

Co-Led the development of Uber's serverless platform, facilitating the migration of infrastructure to multiple cloud providers.

• Collaborated on cross-team initiatives between fleet reliability & security, enhancing operational efficiency.
• Key contributor to Uber PKI, focusing on CAs and Bastions for Uber production.
• Developed JIT (Just In Time) access for ssh. Expanded this to a unified JIT offering available for all Uber privilege escalations.

positions.title: Senior Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Software development and systems engineering for Uber Metal as part of the infrastructure engineering organization. Typical languages include Go & Python, among having a working knowledge of others. Deployments often require creating portable multi-container applications utilizing docker. Deploying and supporting configuration management tools such as Puppet, Chef, & Ansible. Deploying small and large-scale storage solutions utilizing Elasticsearch, MySQL, Postgres & Lustre while supporting HDFS, Spark, S3, and additional technologies. This role works in a hybrid enviroment, integrating on-prem hardware solutions with cloud-based environments, to provide a combination of reliability, dynamic scalability, and high availability, while focusing on resource efficiency and performance.
Prior to Feb '19, my team was formally under Map Making Infrastructure - Compute Platform:
      Full stack engineering and service management supporting integrated map making operations in the U.S. & India. This position encompassed being an SRE to our local datacenter while simultaneously developing & maturing a CDN providing critical infrastructure for over two thousand map making operators. I also developed multiple monitoring pipelines supporting our data center infrastructure, hardware and network, while providing and supporting critical services to our machine learning, computer vision, image collection, and other advanced map-making teams. Being an SRE requires developing distributed systems for configuration management and batch processing. One major project was developing a datacenter monitoring hardware solution integrated with a ticketing system and chat bot for physical device remediation. Additionally, I mentor junior engineers on project development, including distributed systems & service architecture, integration, and configuration management.

positions.title: Network Engineer
positions.description:
Hired on to assist the transition of a Bing Maps datacenter from Microsoft ownership (full Microsoft stack) to Open source over the course of a year. This included hundreds of PB of imagery data and other valuable information, assisting in the development and architecture of the tools to support the infrastructure to ingest and provide all this information to external teams. 
Network technologies implemented were based on Mellanox and Cisco network equipment. Software technologies ranged from TSQL, VMM, SCOM (all Microsoft) to Icinga, Docker, PXE and additional open-source solutions.

positions.title: Lead Technical Consultant
positions.description:
As the technical lead for the Alaska Tax Revenue Management System Project, I was responsible for owning, developing, testing, training and managing multiple subsystems, including security, imaging, data warehouse, mail, design control, discovery and analytics. This included test-driven development, requirement gathering, design sessions, demonstrations, user interface design and more. I worked with two to four subordinates, depending on the subsystem design and did most of the more-complex development as well as documentation, verification, troubleshooting and gaining approval from the client throughout every step of system development. I maintained over 60 databases, six servers and 12 paper modification devices including high volume printers, envelope openers, sorters and stuffers. My responsibilities included:
•	Provide technical representation, system design, regulatory software design documentation and leadership on the project and to the team from definition to delivery at a peer level with the design project architect
•	Support Project Management in the definition and technical validation of delivery schedules and plans
•	Lead a small team of developers and client staff, providing technical instructions to ensure implementation is correct and working with or acting as Iteration Manager to ensure ongoing review of design software delivery plans
•	Work collaboratively to ensure consistent and regular reviews of progress and software releases including escalation of any risks or deviations from the plan with recommendations and mitigation strategies, as appropriate
•	Manage purchasing, hardware specification procurement 
•	SCADA & PLC programming for enveloping systems
•	Develop schematic drawings in accordance with specification
•	Disaster recovery planning and implementation	•	Setup, design, configuration and maintenance of n-tier environments including: Application, Web, DB servers
•	Production optimization & application troubleshooting

positions.title: Electrical & Software Engineer
positions.description: A temporary contract position implementing the hardware, software, interfacing and controls systems for a start-up in 3D printing, scanning and manufacturing. I performed all hardware acquisition, PAC programming, control systems and power interconnects. I developed technical processes and developed the entire website, online storefront..

positions.title: IT Manager
positions.description:
Full time position held concurrent with a full time engineering coursework.

I managed technical and information systems for 80 employees across 5 locations in the Bozeman area, where system performance of operational equipment, sales platforms, and network security was crucial to business. I maintained over 15 SCADA-controlled devices that automated the production of Schnee’s world-famous Pac boots, clothing and accessories. 
 	I successfully managed the merging of two inventory operating systems, each with approximately 20 thousand unique items and 10 thousand similar items. I managed the subsequent changeover of 'point of sale', accounting, financial reports and purchasing functions to one unified system and software set. I set up wide area network security custom fit for specific point of sale operability and a flexible phone system saving more than 20% in administrative costs.  I single handedly installed and managed the entire LAN and phone network, using multiple protocols for a multimillion dollar location performing high-capacity sales through various channels. Additionally, I tutored users in Microsoft Word, Power Point, and proprietary system procedures.

positions.title: IT Developer
positions.description: Paid internship through The U of M College of technology responsible for changing not-for-credit classes over from paper registration to online registration.

positions.title: Technical Service Representative
positions.description: As a customer service representative, I was required to navigate through multiple data entry, information systems and other relevant applications, tools and resources while speaking with customers. I answered customer questions and resolved issues in a professional and courteous manner. I was initially trained for five weeks, learning to initiate interactions resulting in adequate customer satisfaction. Throughout my employment, I maintained metrics exceeding company requirements in terms of productivity and quality standards. I acquired extensive product and system knowledge, necessary to diagnose an issue, then present and enact a resolution.  I learned to effectively assess customer needs and position products with services appropriately to best suit the customer’s needs. I received more than five weeks of formal training in these areas.

positions.title: Warehouse & Compliance Manager's Assistant
positions.description:
College intern position. 
Processed and catalogued incoming supplies. Delivered materials to substation construction sites. Aided crews of up to 12 linemen in the construction of two substations, including filing development reports, and photographing the process. I was an integral part of the switch-out of twelve thousand non-AMR (Automated Meter Reading) wattage-hour meters, a multi-million dollar project which significantly increased company efficiency. I kept the supply yard and adjacent warehouse clean, organized and functional for the team of 20 linemen and foremen, who worked in and around this area, daily. Kept stock and consignment areas full of supplies. I operated an eight-ton forklift daily, to move valuable incoming and outgoing freight. I also helped keep a fleet of 16 utility trucks and business vehicles presentable and operational.

volunteerExperiences.description: Mentoring high school students using robotics to compete in state and national challenges. \
I was an officer and a founding member of the Capital City Toastmasters.

projects.title: State of Alaska Tax Revenue Management System (AK TRMS)
projects.description: 	I was the technical lead for implementing the entire state’s new tax revenue management system. This included bringing online approximately 60 databases encompassing over 100,000 tables and converting terabytes of legacy data. These databases spanned development, testing/training and production environments, I would migrate database and code changes up this stack as new code & DB functionality was verified. It was my responsibility to set up these databases initially, configuring connectivity, windows authentication, service accounts, encryption (TDE), & other security, as well as creating transactional backups on NAS, a mirrored SAN, triggers, views, indexes, and table structures. Additionally, I handled optimization, verifying 99% of transactions occurred within 500ms, and forcing all reporting data to look at the synchronized version of production data, thereby minimizing blocking & deadlocking.

projects.title: Quantel Lasers' Motorized Variable Optical Attenuator (MVAT)
projects.description: A proof of concept, using revolutionary the technology of a PCB motor.

testScores.name: Fundamentals of Engineering Exam
testScores.description: I passed the Fundamentals of Engineering exam. This is the first step towards obtaining my Professional Engineering degree.
